triplets.tail: 4-tuple (S, A, P, R) plus discount factor γ

triplets.head: Markov Decision Process
triplets.tail: Future depends only on present state, not history

triplets.head: Markov Decision Process
triplets.tail: Find optimal policy π* maximizing E[Σ γ^t R(s_t, a_t)]

triplets.head: Markov Decision Process

triplets.head: Bellman Equation
triplets.tail: Applied Dynamic Programming (1962) with Stuart Dreyfus

triplets.head: Bellman Equation
triplets.tail: An optimal policy has the property that whatever the initial state and decision are, the remaining decisions must constitute an optimal policy with regard to the resulting state

triplets.head: Bellman Equation
triplets.tail: V^π(s) = Σ_a π(a|s) Σ_{s'} P(s'|s,a)[R(s,a) + γV^π(s')]

triplets.head: Bellman Equation
triplets.tail: Q*(s,a) = Σ_{s'} P(s'|s,a)[R(s,a) + γ max_{a'} Q*(s',a')]

triplets.head: Bellman Equation
triplets.tail: Recursive decomposition of long-horizon problems; foundation for value iteration, policy iteration, TD learning, Q-learning; enables bootstrapping

triplets.head: Q-Learning

triplets.head: Q-Learning
triplets.tail: Watkins & Peter Dayan, 'Technical Note: Q-Learning', Machine Learning journal, Vol. 8, 1992

triplets.head: Q-Learning
triplets.tail: Model-free, off-policy, converges to Q* given infinite exploration

triplets.head: Q-Learning
triplets.tail: Q(s_t, a_t) ← Q(s_t, a_t) + α[R_{t+1} + γ max_{a'} Q(s_{t+1}, a') − Q(s_t, a_t)]

triplets.head: DQN
triplets.tail: Replace Q-table with deep CNN as Q-function approximator; ~1.7M parameters instead of 10^70,000 entries

triplets.head: DQN
triplets.tail: Conv1(32,8×8,stride4,ReLU) → Conv2(64,4×4,stride2,ReLU) → Conv3(64,3×3,stride1,ReLU) → FC(512,ReLU) → Output(one Q-value per action)

triplets.head: DQN
triplets.tail: L(θ) = E[(r + γ max_{a'} Q(s',a';θ⁻) − Q(s,a;θ))²]

triplets.head: Tabular Q-Learning
triplets.tail: Curse of dimensionality: cannot store table and no generalization across states

triplets.head: Naive neural net + Q-learning
triplets.tail: Correlated sequential data (consecutive frames nearly identical)

triplets.head: Naive neural net + Q-learning
triplets.tail: Non-stationary targets (target depends on same parameters being updated)

triplets.head: Naive neural net + Q-learning
triplets.tail: Feedback loops (policy changes → data distribution changes → Q changes)

triplets.head: Experience Replay
triplets.tail: Store (s, a, r, s') tuples in replay buffer (capacity ~1,000,000); sample random mini-batch (e.g., 32) uniformly during training

triplets.head: Experience Replay
triplets.tail: Breaks temporal correlations; reuses data efficiently; prevents catastrophic forgetting; smooths data distribution

triplets.head: Target Network
triplets.tail: Maintain two copies: Q-network (θ, updated every step) and target network (θ⁻, frozen); every C steps (e.g., 10,000) copy θ → θ⁻

triplets.head: Target Network
triplets.tail: y = r + γ max_{a'} Q(s', a'; θ⁻)

triplets.head: Target Network
triplets.tail: Stable targets; breaks feedback loops; reduces oscillation/divergence

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network
triplets.tail: MSE between predicted value v_θ(s) and game outcome z

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network
triplets.tail: 30M positions from 30M separate self-play games (1 position per game to avoid overfitting)

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network
triplets.tail: Sample timestep U~Uniform{1,450}; moves 1 to U-1 from SL policy; move U random; moves U+1 to end from RL policy; save only (s_{U+1}, z_{U+1})

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network

triplets.head: AlphaGo Value Network
triplets.tail: Single v_θ(s) evaluation ≈ accuracy of 15,000 Monte Carlo rollouts

triplets.head: AlphaGo MCTS

triplets.head: AlphaGo MCTS
triplets.tail: Expansion: add leaf node, initialize priors P(s,a) from SL policy

triplets.head: AlphaGo MCTS
triplets.tail: Evaluation: value network v_θ(leaf) + rollout policy to game end → blend
